(a) You could arrange your books by travel destination themes—say, guides to different regions on one shelf, photography from your trips on another—and mix in small souvenirs or postcards for visual rhythm. (d) You could arrange your books by color or topic—say, fiction on one shelf, nonfiction on another—and mix in small plants or framed photos for visual interest. Use open shelving so titles are easy to scan at a glance, and stagger a few upright books with horizontal stacks to create a balanced, pleasing display.
